Title: Guided Sake Tasting in Asakusa Tokyo: 10 Kinds of Sake
Description:
Discover the nuances and intricacies of Japanese sake in this tasting in Asakusa, led by a specialized native English speaker. Your tasting expert host will introduce you to the basics of sake, including how to recognize different varieties and flavor notes, and share stories about Japan’s sake culture. This session focuses on tasting and understanding sake. It’s designed for beginners who want to explore sake flavors in a relaxed setting.

You will taste up to 10 kinds (depending on your choices) out of over 50 options. If you've never had sake before or are unsure where to start, your host will provide guidance and share advice so you can find your new favorite.

The sake selection in this experience is meant to showcase and highlight breweries from all over Japan, from historical crafters that adhere to longstanding traditional methods to contemporary brewers with less orthodox ways. Sip through distinct varieties to savor their differences and deepen your understanding of Japan's national drink in a beginner-friendly, relaxed setting only a few minutes from Asakusa Station.

Title: Sake Tasting Lesson with Sommelier in Asakusa Tokyo
Description:
Sake is a key part of Japanese culture, from its traditional brewing methods designated an Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO to the many celebrations where it's served, enjoyed and shared. With countless varieties and subtle nuances, however, exploring the world of sake can be overwhelming at first. That's where the guidance and knowledge of a professional proves invaluable.

Your host is an English-speaking sake sommelier who uses his extensive experience living abroad to share his passion for the sake of the world. With contagious enthusiasm, he will show you what makes sake so special, how to differentiate between varieties, and how to find the best variety to suit your tastebuds.

You'll start with a 30-minute workshop led by Hide on all things sake. Learn about how it's made, its many varieties, and its impact on Japanese culture. What are the unique processes of making sake? What kind of rituals and ceremonies feature sake? Find the answers to all your pressing questions from Hide.

Next, enjoy tasting up to 10 varieties of sake from across Japan. Guided by Hide, you can choose from over 50 varieties, from dry to sweet, cloudy to sharp, sparkling or still. Your host will support you in finding your new favorite and even purchase a bottle to take home if you'd like.

Discover the drink that captivates a nation in this approachable, beginner-friendly sake workshop and tasting led by an expert in the field.

Title: Unlimited Sake Tasting in Asakusa Tokyo
Description:
Highlights

  • Unlimited Sampling from 50 varieties of upscale sake from all over Japan.
  • Enjoy diverse sake types: from premium and traditional to fruit-flavored, seasonal, unpasteurized, cloudy, sparkling, and aged.
  • Ideal for sake enthusiasts and beginners alike
  • Located in the heart of Asakusa

Details

Join a relaxed and beginner-friendly sake tasting experience in the heart of Asakusa, just minutes from Asakusa Station. Enjoy unlimited tastings of over 50 types of sake from across Japan—drink as much as you like!

No prior knowledge is needed. Your English-speaking host will help you through the world of sake,  explaining the unique characteristics of different varieties.

Explore the rich diversity of Japan’s national drink, from traditional brews crafted by historic breweries to innovative styles made by modern producers. Each sake has been carefully selected by an expert to showcase the best of Japan’s regional and artisanal brewing.

After the tasting, you’ll also have the chance to purchase your favorite bottles to take home.

Discover the flavors, stories, and culture behind sake in a welcoming and educational setting—perfect for both first-timers and enthusiasts alike.
